segments.text: A young Illuminator who resides in Rosecrown Beacon, the little sister of Mildia Dream and partner of Alina Nightsong. She relies heavily on her sister but is not aware of it herself.
She works hard to pass the Arboranger test to fight Darkritters.
In reality, Fancia is actually a member of the Light Pollution and holds the position of vice leader, opposing the Arborangers.

A young Illuminator from Earthcaress Beacon, currently residing in Rosecrown Beacon, partner of Fancia Dream. She has a straightforward personality that sometimes causes trouble. Therefore, Fancia always takes care of her.

In reality, Alina Nightsong is the Captain of the Arborangers. Possessing both courage and bravery, she accomplished great feats in the defense battle in Starshard Beacon and was then promoted to leader, assisting the Sages in neutralizing the threat of Darkritters and Light Pollution.

An Illuminator of few words but sharp remarks. She is independent, frequently appears, and soon vanishes unexpectedly. Despite her small stature, she possesses exceptional power. It seems that she has a long history with Mildia Dream and was entrusted by her to train Fancia and Alina.

Tinia Lori is the "imaginary friend" that everyone had in their childhood. For Fancia, she needs a senior who can appear at any time and accompany her, and a teacher who can guide her to catch up with her friends.

The elder sister of Fancia Dream and the former Captain of the Arborangers. It is said that she is the strongest Illuminator of her generation, but she suffered a permanent leg injury during a mission and unfortunately had to resign and return home. Because of her own experience, she has been hindering her sister, Fancia, from becoming an Arboranger.
In reality, former Arboranger leader Mildia Dream unexpectedly died when going out on a mission.
Mysterious Illuminator who knows a lot about Noctuary.
The fortune-teller in the Main Beacon's market, self-proclaimed as a deity, speaks ambiguously and seems to enjoy playing tricks on others.
The Sage from the Main Beacon, the spiritual leader of the Illuminator society. She is extremely busy with work, handling various affairs of the society every day.

In reality, Bonfia is just an older Illuminator whose appearance does not match her age. She always speaks in a tired and helpless tone, and when facing decisions, she always considers the gains and losses of everyone and the overall interests of Inlixaland.

She is one of the Sages and is known as a "non-luminous Illuminator." As the inventor of the Illumiarms and an omniscient scholar, she has a rather eccentric personality and prefers seclusion and conducting research known only to herself. However, she is by no means indifferent to Inlixaland.

Noxistasia Shade turns out to be the mastermind behind everything, she is so deranged that she intends to single-handedly end the eternal night that has been overshadowing Inlixaland for three hundred years and bring the entire Inlixaland into her desired Dreamland.

She is the deity of the ancient Illuminator civilization and the most powerful Illuminator in history, the "sun" of the world. It is under her radiance that Illuminators are able to live normal lives. To show respect, Illuminators named the land they reside in after her name.

As a powerful leader, Inlixa Solar might think that she should shoulder every responsibility because she was capable —even if working too hard undermined her health. The extinction of Inlixa's light triggered a catastrophe, the Eternal Night Calamity, followed by the protracted War of Inlixa.
Lumina Fullmoon is an ancient Illuminator and one of the Sages who led the fledgling Illuminator civilization through crises.
In the War of Inlixa, she grew tired of conflicts and fled into the Land of Darkness with Inlixa's body.
She is the owner of the endless Dreamland Fancia and Alina fell into.

She lives in Rosecrown Beacon. Due to the loss of her partner, she often speaks sarcastically, doubts and mocks everything. At the same time, the relationship with her younger sister, Genia Cold, seems to have turned quite awkward…

A mysterious Illuminator suddenly appeared in Rosecrown Beacon. She calls herself Lumina Fullmoon and claims to be from Highmoon Beacon, but has lost most of her memories. As a result, she has a strong curiosity about everything and occasionally says strange things.
This Lumina is just half the soul of the real Lumina Fullmoon in the Dreamland, the half of her that wishes to end the dream and face reality for some unknown purpose.
Another existence that self-proclaims to be Lumina, apparently wishing Fancia and others to live peacefully here.

This Lumina is half of the real Lumina Fullmoon's soul in the Dreamland. She wants to indulge in the hapinness of the eternal Dreamland, antagonizing her other half and effectively keeping the real Lumina trapped in the dream.
A tall Illuminator whose face is difficult to see due to the hood she wears. She resides near Earthcaress Beacon in the forest.
Lura's personality is actually gentler than what her appearance suggests. She has a loyal Darkritter named "Lamp Spirit" living inside her lantern.

Some Illuminators say that her Darkriters manipulation ability is actually a terrible disease… but she never gave up on herself. She persists in finding a way for Illuminators and Darkritters to coexist.
Captain of the Arborangers, one of the administrators of Inlixaland. High-ranking yet approachable. It is said that she handles most of the daily affairs inside the Main Beacon.
Intimia was actually killed during a massive attack by Darkritters.

She is a polite, modest, and knowledgeable Illuminator and is able to answer many uncommon questions. Although she is the most frequently relied-upon Arboranger in Earthcaress Beacon, almost no one has seen her fighting. Generally, she is only responsible for strategizing and planning.
Long ago, in order to save the dying Lanteria, Tranquillia transferred her soul into a newborn Illuminator: committing this sin was a "necessary evil" for her.

She is an outgoing and carefree Illuminator, born and raised in Earthcaress Beacon, sometimes a bit naive, but overall easy to get along with. However, her characteristics will make others occasionally forget that she is actually an experienced Arboranger.
It turns out that the actual Lanteria is a fusion of souls, and also a manufactured heroine.
In reality, Lanteria has become the head of Earthcaress beacon and she bears the expectations of the Beacon's Illuminators such as Tranquillia.
Passionate tavern owner, good at brewing wine and listening to others, widely welcome among Illuminators. Toast To Wine was once located at several beacons but finally settled in Rosecrown Beacon.

A doctor from Rosecrown Beacon. She has a serious characteristic and cares not only about the physical condition of Illuminators but also offers her own opinions on their lifestyles. Some Illuminators think she speaks too directly, but no one questions that her intentions are always good.
In reality, Puria Crystal has become the head of Rosecrown Beacon, busy every day.
Lura's loyal Darkritter living inside her lantern. It is fluent in speaking and even more eloquent than its master.

An Illuminator dressed in magnificent attire, in charge of Starshard Beacon, with formidable combat abilities. Although she leaves an impression of confidence and strength on others, in daily life, she is actually friendly and cares about other Illuminators. In a sense, she can be considered as someone with a cold face but a warm heart.
She is the de facto leader of Light Pollution rebel group opposing the Main Beacon and Bonfia Flame leadership.
She hates this painful and uncontrollable reality, even more so since Intimia’s death. Therefore, she has been trying to find a way to change the current situation and destroy Darkritters.
An Illuminator from Lightfall Beacon, currently responsible for navigation on the sea, in other words, she drives boats. She seems to dislike the land and displays a timid side upon returning to it.

Before becoming a navigator on the sea, she used to work in a mine near Starshard Beacon, responsible for the guiding work as well. Witnessing various tragic events in the mine left her with psychological trauma, but she never shirks her responsibilities as an Arboranger.
An artificial Illuminator.
She driven by the commands of Genia in the base of Light Pollution.
She searchs for the meaning of life. Before she ever knew what she was born for, she was already determined to sacrifice her life for others.
The model used by Genia to create Fabrica was her older sister, Brita.

A young Arboranger who ran away from home and now lives in the Main Beacon, often helping others. She is gentle, kind, and enthusiastic. She seems to have a strong interest in science, technology and the knowledge of ancient Illuminator civilization, and when it comes to related topics, she talks endlessly.

In order to change her older sister's disaproval and attitude towards herself, Genia Cold embarked on a solitary journey to seek knowledge from the Sage Noxistasia Shade, wanting to learn ancient technology and eventually become a technical officer of Light Pollution.
Also, she created Fabrica with Noxistasia's help.
An experienced Arboranger who has a remarkably fashionable dressing style.
In reality, she's one of the chief executives of the organization "Light Pollution," who is extremely loyal to her leader.

She earned the trust of her teammates in Light Pollution. With strong endurance, she is known as "Unbeatable Nacrotia" and is capable of engaging in prolonged battles. However, she seems a bit gullible.
An Illuminator belonging to the elite force of Starshard Beacon, somewhat uncommunicative. She always dresses in dark colors, which might benefit her movement at night.
Spectrica seems to trust her very much as Kira is her henchwoman. She is one of the vice leaders of Light Pollution.

She is good at infiltrating, and is strong when fighting in head-on combat. It is said that she is way stronger when she fights Illuminators instead of Darkritters. However, as a teammate, she is always reliable.

An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the elder sister of Blessa Comet, the main vocalist of a super-popular band, "Starkiss." She hopes that her singing can guide more newborn Illuminators who are still wandering in the wild.
During the chaos caused by Spectrica's imprisonment, Wishia Comet was entrusted to be the administrator of Starshard Beacon.

An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the younger sister of Wishia Comet, the bassist and vice vocalist of the super-popular band, "Starkiss." She is responsible for logistics support, and purchasing props, and food when needed.

fter the fall of Starshard Beacon, Blessa Comet followed in the footsteps of Wishia, fighting alongside the original members of "Starkiss" to defend their homeland. Diligent and dedicated, she never takes any mission lightly.

An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the keyboardist in the super-popular band, "Starkiss." She is responsible for handling the external affairs of the band. When the band encounters matters requiring external negotiation, she is usually the one to handle it. She is a retired Arboranger.

Now that Wishia and Blessa have picked up their Illumiarms and entered the battlefield, Adorna Starcloud, the oldest member in the squad, will of course stick together with the other members. Adorna was responsible for the training of this idol band, helping them become reliable warriors.
An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the drummer in the super popular band, "Starkiss." She is in charge of choosing the concert locations and the event times… via fortunetelling.

Even the most dim-witted Illuminator can sense a crisis coming after the fall of Starshard Beacon. As her teammates joined the battle, Duskia Jove made the same "fateful" decision just as she did when she joined Starkiss —pick up her Illumiarm and defend the beacon.

An Illuminator living in the forest near the Starshard Beacon. She is the guest violinist of the super-popular band, "Starkiss." Although the public often regards her as a member of the band, she does not seem to agree.

Fluoresca's relationship with Starkiss members existed only in Dreamland. In reality she never made friends with them and has already died… but fragments of her soul are still being carried by those flickering fireflies in Inlixaland.
An Illuminator of ancient civilization and Noxistasia's tutor.

Ms. Farlight later became a member of the nobility with her own effort. As a result, she was incredibly powerful and knowledgeable. She helped all those who were discriminated against and overlooked because she thought there should not be any difference between Illuminators.
